summary: 19-year-old man went missing overnight near Dutch George Campground in the Poudre Canyon; Larimer County SAR with two SARDOC dog teams searched through the night without success, and more searchers continued April 12; he was located around 4 p.m. in Glacier View, outside the search area.
notes: Date Friday-verified. Report header 'April 11-12, 2014' followed (in-body '4/11/2015' is a typo); subject located ~1600 on 4/12.
